providerEditor.mcpGrokHint: Grok has no flag: Vertragus merges [mcp_servers.vertragus] into .grok/config.toml and allows the tools via --allow. Orchestrators also get a permission cage.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Applies to Vertragus as a whole.
settings.agentPolicyAskUser: Ask user — the CLI asks in its terminal (native Cursor stays Run Everything)
settings.agentPolicyAskOrchestrator: Ask orchestrator — risky actions need its approval
settings.agentPolicyHint: Yolo: full autonomy. Ask user: the CLI's own permission prompt waits for you in the agent terminal (hard boundary). Ask orchestrator: subagents run autonomously, but their contract requires the orchestrator's approval before risky actions (soft boundary — see the README threat model). Native Cursor is always Run Everything so Auto-review cannot still block MCP.
settings.cliSurfaceSession: Session — one Vertragus view for every CLI
settings.cliSurfaceRaw: Native CLI — the provider’s own TUI
settings.cliSurfaceHint: Session paints status, branch, questions and follow-ups from host events, so Cursor, Claude and Codex windows look the same. Native CLI is one click in the title bar (needed for permission prompts). Waiting-for-MCP still shows the raw TUI so leftover Cursor approvals can be clicked.
settings.piHarnessHint: Off by default. On: the roster still says Claude, Cursor, Codex, Kimi, Grok or Ollama — only the process is the bundled Pi CLI, with the slot's model and a mapped Pi backend. Native CLIs are not spawned. Takes effect on the next Play. PATH pi is the fallback if the package is missing. Cursor maps to github-copilot; Ollama has no Pi backend, so only --model is passed. Pi has no permission prompts, so native yolo flags are not forwarded. On Windows the wrap needs Node.js on PATH (ConPTY cannot host electron.exe); POSIX runs Electron as Node.
settings.hotkeyHint: Electron format: join modifiers with +, e.g. Control+Alt+V. Takes effect right after saving.
settings.autostartHint: Vertragus starts automatically after you sign in.
settings.autostartUnsupported: Installed app only: in a dev run the login item would point at the Electron binary.
settings.reflowNeighborsHint: When you move an agent window or a zone, the others fill the gap. Off: only this window moves.
settings.updateChannelHint: main delivers fixes fastest, stable only tagged versions.
settings.themeHint: Takes effect immediately — in this window and every other one.
settings.localeHint: Takes effect immediately — in this window and in every other one.
settings.voiceEnabledHint: Off: the microphone stays closed. On: Vertragus listens for the wake phrase.
settings.voiceProviderHint: Which realtime API speaks. Each provider has its own key.
settings.voiceWakePhraseHint: The word or phrase Vertragus listens for in the room.
settings.voiceVoiceIdHint: xAI: eve, ara, leo. OpenAI: alloy, verse. Empty uses the provider default.
settings.voiceApiKeyHint: From Settings or the XAI_API_KEY environment variable. Leave empty to keep the stored key.
settings.voiceApiKeySet: Set — leave empty to keep it
settings.voiceOpenaiApiKeyHint: From Settings or the OPENAI_API_KEY environment variable. Leave empty to keep the stored key.
settings.voiceOpenaiApiKeySet: Set — leave empty to keep it
settings.voiceInputDeviceHint: Used for speech recognition. Empty is the system default.
settings.voiceOutputDeviceHint: Used for spoken replies. Empty is the system default.
settings.voiceDeviceMissing: The saved device is gone — the system default is used until you pick another.

mcp.title: MCP servers
mcp.hint: Extra servers attach to subagents only, not the orchestrator. Changes apply the next time an agent starts. Environment and header values stay in plaintext in vertragus-v2.json — empty fields keep a stored secret. Applies to Claude, Codex, Kimi and Cursor — not Ollama. With the Pi wrap on, extras attach for every slot including Ollama. Headers travel with Claude, Kimi and Cursor; Codex HTTP extras are URL-only.
mcp.idHint: Letters, digits, dashes or underscores — no dots. Renaming keeps stored secrets.
mcp.label: Display name
mcp.commandHint: Program name, looked up on PATH — not a shell line.
mcp.envHint: KEY=value, one per line. Leave the value empty to keep a stored secret.
mcp.headersHint: Name: value, one per line. Leave the value empty to keep a stored secret. Claude, Kimi and Cursor send them; Codex HTTP is URL-only.

settings.translucentHint: Windows sit over the desktop as glass. Off: everything is fully opaque.
settings.translucentOffHint: Transparency is off. The sliders keep their values and apply again as soon as you switch it back on.
settings.glassLadderHint: Rest <= hover <= focus - smaller values are lifted automatically.

glassSlider.hoverOpacityHint: How visible a window becomes once the mouse is over it.
glassSlider.focusOpacityHint: Applies to agent windows that are being typed in.
glassSlider.surfaceTransparencyHint: 0 % paints the surfaces themselves solid, 100 % is the designed glass - independent of the opacity above.

browserExtension.title: Browser extension
browserExtension.body: Pair the unpacked Chromium extension so a worker can drive the tabs you already have open — logged-in apps included. This is not a second MCP server: workers call browser_* tools on their existing Vertragus identity. A disconnected extension is a tool error, never a silent skip.
browserExtension.installHint: Opens chrome://extensions and the unpacked folder. Then Developer mode → Load unpacked, and paste the pairing URL in the extension popup.
browserExtension.installOpened: Opened the extensions page and the folder. Load unpacked, then paste the pairing URL.
browserExtension.installFolderOnly: No Chromium browser found. The folder is open — in Chromium open chrome://extensions → Developer mode → Load unpacked.
browserExtension.missingFolder: The extension files are missing. Rebuild or reinstall Vertragus, then try again.
browserExtension.installRevealFailed: Could not open the extension folder.
browserExtension.installFailed: Could not start the Chromium install helper.
browserExtension.loadUnpacked: After Install: Developer mode → Load unpacked (the folder is already open), then paste the pairing URL in the extension popup.
browserExtension.regenerateHint: Disconnects the extension and changes the URL. Use this if the URL leaked.
browserExtension.warnYolo: A yolo-mode worker can click, type and screenshot any tab the extension can see. Pair only while you are watching the run.
